articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
articles.snippet: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

articles.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial plans token buyback after 66% year-to-date slide
articles.snippet: The crypto venture may use fees from its USD1 stablecoin reserves to fund token purchases as it seeks to boost governance.

articles.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
articles.snippet: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.

articles.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

articles.title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
articles.snippet: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.
